A case-control study11 also found an increased risk, but of a much smaller magnitude, and another cohort study12 (including DESAD data) found no support for a greatly increased risk of hypospadias. The earlier cohort study that reported the greatly increased risk may have been affected by factors related to infer- tility, as the study was done in a cohort of subfertile women, about half of whom had undergone IVF.
